text:
Maria Chen: Quick thread — proposed webinar run-of-show tweak: shift the bench demo to earlier so we show 'latency first' for live audience in NA, then deep-dive for APAC recording.
Ben O'Neill: makes sense. NA live audience wants snappy wins early. Can we reduce the long-running rerank demo? it's prone to timeouts.
Oliver Park: Agree. Suggest a fallback 'cached-embeds' shortcut if rerank exceeds 6s.
Maria Chen: Good call. We'll add fallback note. @Alex Rivera can you own the fallback slide + one-liner?
Alex Rivera: I can. I'll make a 2-slide fallback: 1) what triggers fallback, 2) observed perf change (+ sample tps). ETA EOD Wed.
DemoBot: Scheduled rehearsal: 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT (auto)
Ben O'Neill: Also need speaker cue cards for staggered APAC recording — who will run the recorder?
Oliver Park: I can handle the recorder for APAC. Need a checklist: mic test, tokens for private demo, snapshot of perf logs.
Maria Chen: Copy this checklist into the runbook. Also, let's add an audience poll after the live demo: 'What's your top tradeoff? cost/latency/reliability' — options: cost, latency, reliability, other.
Alex Rivera: adding poll
Maria Chen: demo: run-of-show snippet:
```
00:00 - Host intro (3m)
03:00 - Bench demo: latency-first (10m)
13:00 - Deep dive: batching & quantization (12m)
25:00 - Q&A + poll (10m)
35:00 - Closing & CTA (5m)
```
Ben O'Neill: If we hit the rerank fallback, present it as 'engineering tradeoff' not a failure.
Maria Chen: Agree. Tone: 'how we kept live demos reliable' + show pre-recorded clip as backup.
Oliver Park: I'll capture a 30s pre-recorded clip of the rerank fallback.
Alex Rivera: Need slide deck link + speaker notes by EOD Thu. Ping me here when uploaded.
Maria Chen: tagging speakers: @Ben O'Neill @Oliver Park @Alex Rivera please confirm ownership and any blockers.
Ben O'Neill: Confirmed. no blockers.
Oliver Park: Confirmed. mic already reserved.
Alex Rivera: Confirmed. will post link when done. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll update the runbook and post final schedule tomorrow. :rocket:
